Real Cases, Real Solutions

Problems We’ve Solved for Neighbors

Every pest problem is different, as is the solution. Here are some standard cases we have come across — and how we solved them.

Trouble with Ants

A real estate client noticed sawdust falling from rafters on a screened-in porch. Inspection found a thriving carpenter ant nest. We applied a flushing agent directly, plus a perimeter control spray.

3-Month Guarantee Included

Stopping Rodents

A local educator’s ranch home had mice getting in through a crawl space and piping below the kitchen floor. We set traps in the crawl space, kitchen, garage, and basement — and sealed a small hole in the siding.

30-Day Guarantee Included

Get Those Yellow Jackets

A Trumbull resident had a persistent yellow jacket nest in an upstairs windowsill — and the nest extended back into the woodwork. We applied a dusting the insects tracked back into the depths of the nest.

30-Day Guarantee Included

How It Works

From First Call to Problem Solved

No pushy plans, no surprises — just an honest solution to your pest problem.

1

Tell Us the Problem

Call (203) 505-0989 and describe what you’re seeing. We’ll talk through similar cases and what they cost.

2

Inspection

We inspect the problem area — and look for how pests are getting in, not just where you see them.

3

Targeted Treatment

The right treatment in the right place: flushing agents, perimeter sprays, traps, or dusting tracked into the nest.

4

Guaranteed

Every treatment includes our standard 30-day guarantee — 3 months on ant treatments.
